extDescription.message: Switch between Autodarts accounts on a shared display with one tap, without signing in again.
extDescription.description: The description of the extension, at most 132 characters.

unsavedText.message: Someone is signed in on Autodarts who isn't saved here yet.

removeConfirm.message: Remove $NAME$ from this display? Sign in again to add the account back.

passwordHint.message: Only used when the saved sign-in stops working. It stays on this computer and goes only to Autodarts.

switchSignIn.message: $NAME$ has to sign in again: sign in once on Autodarts and save the account, or remember the password.

unreachable.message: Autodarts can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.

noPage.message: Open or reload play.autodarts.com in a tab, then try again.

empty.message: No accounts yet. Sign in on play.autodarts.com, then save the account here.

addHint.message: Signed out. Sign in on Autodarts with the next account, then open this again to save it.

error.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
